runId: null when runtime-journal.enabled is false: no journal, so no run id (RuntimeJournalStatusDto)
oldestRetainedAt: null while the journal retains no event, as in BootUI (RuntimeJournalStatusDto)
totals: null: sharpit records no resource track or CPU ledger yet; U20 fills the memory keys (RuntimeResourcesDto)
persistenceOption: null: sharpit has no activity persistence option; Live Activity reads the in-memory panel buffers
kpis.heapUsedBytes: null: sharpit samples no process memory for Live Activity (RuntimeResourcesDto is unavailable too)
kpis.heapMaxBytes: null: sharpit samples no process memory for Live Activity (RuntimeResourcesDto is unavailable too)
kpis.healthStatus: null until the health panel has run: a read never runs a check, so only a cached status shows
